description.narrative: The Multilateral Debt Relief Initiative (MDRI) was created to cancel the International Development Association debt of some of the world’s poorest countries. The objective is to provide additional support to Heavily Indebted Poor Countries to reach the Millennium Development Goals , while preserving the financing capacity of the International Financial Institutions. Funding under this initiative represents Australia's contribution to MDRI valued at $109.02 million to be expensed during the period 11 June 2014 to 30 June 2025 (as per encashment schedule agreed in IDA17).
